note: Every package of npm-shrinkwrap.json that has an install script (hasInstallScript), with the reason it is there and what keeps its script from running (review round SUP-1). test/unit/tools-install-scripts.test.mjs fails when this list and the shrinkwrap differ: a new entry is a change for the second reviewer.

packages.bufferutil: optional native speed-up of ws; its script builds a native module. Never run: the clone's .npmrc has ignore-scripts=true and every documented install passes --ignore-scripts; ws works without it.
packages.esbuild: dev dependency (the build); its postinstall checks the platform binary that npm installs as an optional dependency. Not in the published package's production tree.
packages.ip-set: transitive through webtorrent > load-ip-set; preinstall 'npx only-allow pnpm' would fetch an unpinned package from the registry. Never run: --ignore-scripts on every install; the code works without it.
packages.node-datachannel: transitive through webtorrent > @thaunknown/simple-peer > webrtc-polyfill; its install downloads a prebuilt native binary (not covered by the lockfile). Never run by an install; tools/seed.mjs tells the owner how to run only this one (npm rebuild node-datachannel --ignore-scripts=false) and what it downloads.
packages.utf-8-validate: optional native speed-up of ws; never run (as bufferutil).
packages.utp-native: optional uTP transport of webtorrent for Node; never run, and the browser loader does not use it.
